name: Potosí

Direct curl rejected the host certificate chain. TLS verification was not disabled and no certificate exception was authorized; no content was treated as retrieved from this request.

Official municipal Servicio de Catastro page identifies the service, municipal contact details, and a generic GAMP Sistemas link, but contains no parcel feature service, viewer endpoint, schema, or CRS.
Direct curl rejected the host certificate chain. No TLS bypass, login, CAPTCHA defeat, or unsafe field request was attempted.

Official municipal page states that the Secretaría de Ordenamiento Territorial Urbano contains the Dirección de Catastro y Desarrollo Urbano and Jefatura de Catastro Urbano. This is local-custodian evidence, not parcel geometry evidence.

Official national ministry page lists the 2022 Guía nacional de catastro urbano. It is standards/context evidence only and does not expose Potosí parcel features.
Bounded anonymous request to an official-looking YPFB ArcGIS administrative municipality layer returned no response. The route is not a verified Potosí parcel service and no geometry was retained.
